input_box_content.user_input_content:
=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven empowered-state reference
for Riven throughout the entire video.

Keep Riven's appearance,
clothing,
armor,
hair,
and physical condition consistent.

Use the provided empowered weapon reference
for Riven's weapon.

The emerald-green empowered weapon
is ALREADY fully active
at the beginning of this scene.

Keep the same empowered weapon
throughout the entire video.

Preserve the same visual design:
dark physical metal at the core,
bright emerald runes,
and translucent green runic energy
forming the larger blade silhouette.

Do not deactivate or transform the weapon.

Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference
for the dark figure.

Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the environment.

Use the provided final frame from Scene 38
as the direct continuity reference.


=== CONTINUITY FROM SCENE 38 ===

Continue directly from the provided final frame.

Riven and the Mysterious Dark Figure
are already facing each other
on the burning village road.

Riven is standing on one side
with the empowered green weapon active.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
stands at fighting distance ahead of her.

Both characters are still.

The fight is about to continue.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Fast,
physical,
readable combat.

Natural body weight
and strong impacts.

Dynamic but controlled cinematic camera movement.

The Mysterious Dark Figure moves
with unnatural speed,
like a dark shape gliding rapidly
through smoke.

Riven remains physical and grounded.

Emerald energy reacts naturally
to the movement and impact
of Riven's weapon.

Natural fire,
wind,
footsteps,
weapon impacts,
heavy breathing,
and environmental sound.

No subtitles.

No background music.

Only one short dialogue line from Riven.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Continue the confrontation
from the end of Scene 38.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
uses its unnatural speed
to attack Riven again.

But Riven no longer desperately follows
every movement.

She stays calm
and begins reading its attack pattern.

She avoids one attack,
blocks another,

then anticipates
where the figure will attack next.

Riven lands
a direct strike
with the empowered green blade.

For the first time,

the Mysterious Dark Figure
is genuinely damaged.

Riven sees the effect
of the emerald energy
and realizes it can be hurt.

She quietly says:

"So you can be hurt."

The figure becomes still.

Dark smoke begins gathering around it.

Something much more dangerous
is beginning.

CUT.


=== SHOT 1 — READ THE MOVEMENT ===

OPEN IMMEDIATELY
from the confrontation
shown in the provided final frame of Scene 38.

Do not recreate
the same wide composition.


Begin much closer.


A low close tracking angle
moves alongside
Riven's empowered green blade.


Emerald energy flows
along the weapon.

Firelight and green light
reflect across the damaged road.


The camera movement reveals Riven.


She is injured
and breathing heavily,

but standing firmly.


Ahead of her,
through the smoke,

the Mysterious Dark Figure
remains at fighting distance.


A brief stillness.


Then—


the figure suddenly moves.


A dark blur
rushes rapidly across the road.


Riven turns toward the movement,

but she does not chase it.


The figure suddenly attacks.


Riven shifts aside
and narrowly avoids it.


The figure immediately
changes direction.


Another dark rush.


Riven turns—

raises the empowered blade—


CLASH.


Emerald energy flashes
at the impact.


Riven remains standing.


The figure rapidly
moves away again.


Riven watches.


She does not immediately attack.


Her breathing becomes more controlled.


She is beginning
to understand how it moves.


=== SHOT 2 — FIRST REAL HIT ===

The Mysterious Dark Figure
moves again.


A rapid dark blur
crosses through the smoke.


Then another direction.


Riven stays grounded.


She follows it with her eyes.


She does not swing blindly.


She waits.


Suddenly—

the figure changes direction
and rushes directly toward her.


This time,

Riven is ready.


She turns at the correct moment.


One powerful,
controlled swing.


The empowered green blade
connects directly
with the Mysterious Dark Figure.


DIRECT HIT.


Emerald-green energy
cuts through part
of its dark silhouette.


Black smoke tears away
from the struck area.


The figure is violently
forced backward.


Where Riven struck it,

bright emerald energy
briefly remains
inside the unstable dark form.


The figure attempts
to reform.


But this time,

the damaged area
does not immediately return to normal.


Its silhouette flickers.


Dark smoke struggles
to reconnect.


Riven sees this.


She stops.


A brief close shot
of Riven watching the damage.


She understands.


The empowered weapon
can actually hurt it.


Still breathing heavily,

without smiling
and without lowering her guard,

Riven quietly says:


"So you can be hurt."


Riven raises
the empowered weapon again.


=== SHOT 3 — THE SHADOW RESPONDS ===

The Mysterious Dark Figure
remains farther down
the burning road.


Its damaged form
slowly begins reforming.


Then—

it becomes completely still.


Riven watches carefully.


A strange change
begins around the figure.


Smoke nearby
starts moving toward it.


At first,

only thin streams.


Then more.


Dark smoke from the burning buildings
begins drawing toward
the Mysterious Dark Figure.


Ash moves across the road.


The smoke around the figure
becomes darker and denser.


Its silhouette becomes
increasingly unstable.


Darkness moves around its body
like living smoke.


Keep the same humanoid entity.


Do not transform it
into a different creature.


Do not reveal a clear face.


Riven notices
what is happening.


She tightens both hands
around the empowered weapon.


The emerald runes
continue glowing strongly.


Green wind-like energy
moves around the blade.


Across the burning road:


EMERALD GREEN around Riven.


GATHERING DARKNESS around the figure.


The Mysterious Dark Figure
remains still
as more darkness gathers around it.


It is preparing
to unleash something much more powerful.


Riven holds her ground.


CUT.


=== END STATE — IMPORTANT FOR SCENE 39B ===

Riven remains standing
with the fully activated
emerald-green empowered weapon.

The weapon stays fully active.

Riven has successfully damaged
the Mysterious Dark Figure
and now understands
that the empowered weapon can hurt it.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
is still alive.

Its damaged body
has mostly reformed.

It remains the same
mysterious humanoid entity.

A large amount of dark smoke
and shadow energy
is now gathering around it.

The figure is preparing
a much stronger attack,

but it has NOT unleashed it yet.

Riven and the Mysterious Dark Figure
remain separated
by clear fighting distance.

Neither character is attacking
at the exact moment of the cut.

Riven is ready.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
is gathering its full power.

CUT.
